note: What column B says, in plain words, when a case is refused. Keyed by the clause the engine names (or "V-11" for a tool outside the adapter's grammar, which the replay refuses before any engine call, as art_harness.py's to_proposal does). The clause itself goes in --json only. A clause missing here prints `refused_unknown`, never a guess.

refused.V-11: the AI agent's tools cannot express this action
refused.8.4-3: no risk rule covers this action
refused.TR-8: the tool's schema is not registered
refused.DR-13: irreversible, and nobody is named to be told
refused.8.3.1: a parameter is outside what the policy reads
